title: Fix flaky timeout in checkpoint.fork.test.ts when run in parallel
description: During the 0jq.12 session, the test 'CheckpointStore.forkFromCheckpoint > forks a checkpoint into an isolated branch + working copy' in packages/core/test/checkpoint.fork.test.ts timed out at the default 5000ms when running the full suite in parallel, but passed reliably when run alone. The test involves a real Dolt binary and file system operations (mkdtempSync, DoltRepo init, commit), so it is sensitive to CPU/IO contention from parallel test execution. Either the timeout needs to be raised for this test, or the test needs isolation from the parallel suite.
close_reason: Raised timeout to 30s on the Dolt fork test; PR #70 open
